name: @solx/widgets
description: Shared toolkit for building solx widgets. defineReactWidget wraps a React component as a self-mounting custom element; createWidgetConfig is a Vite library-mode config producing a single-file ESM bundle; mountWidget is the loader a host page (solx-web) uses to fetch, import, and mount one. Not an installable solx package itself -- no install.solx, nothing registered in the actions database. Consumed straight from TS source: sibling widget packages (e.g. solx-agent) import it by relative path, solx-web aliases it the same way it already aliases @solx/http from the sibling solx-js repo.
